title: Object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first face, which consists of two loops. In the first loop, draw an arc from the point (0.0, 0.003) to (0.003, 0.0) with a midpoint at (0.0009, 0.0009). Follow this with a line from (0.003, 0.0) to (0.0365, 0.0). Then, draw another arc from (0.0365, 0.0) to (0.0395, 0.003) with a midpoint at (0.0386, 0.0009). Continue with a line from (0.0395, 0.003) to (0.0395, 0.0365), followed by an arc from (0.0395, 0.0365) to (0.0365, 0.0395) with a midpoint at (0.0386, 0.0386). Draw a line from (0.0365, 0.0395) to (0.003, 0.0395), then an arc from (0.003, 0.0395) to (0.0, 0.0365) with a midpoint at (0.0009, 0.0386). Finally, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0365) back to (0.0, 0.003). For the second loop, draw a line from (0.003, 0.003) to (0.0365, 0.003), then from (0.0365, 0.003) to (0.0365, 0.0365), followed by a line from (0.0365, 0.0365) to (0.003, 0.0365), and finally from (0.003, 0.0365) back to (0.003, 0.003). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0395. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units in the positive normal direction and 0.0 units in the negative normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the object are length 0.039473684210526314, width 0.039473684210526314, and height 0.75.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the hexagonal base
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.003).threePointArc((0.0009, 0.0009), (0.003, 0.0))
r = r.lineTo(0.0365, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0386, 0.0009), (0.0395, 0.003))
r = r.lineTo(0.0395, 0.0365).threePointArc((0.0386, 0.0386), (0.0365, 0.0395))
r = r.lineTo(0.003, 0.0395).threePointArc((0.0009, 0.0386), (0.0, 0.0365))
r = r.close()

# Create the rectangular top
r = r.moveTo(0.003, 0.003).lineTo(0.0365, 0.003).lineTo(0.0365, 0.0365).lineTo(0.003, 0.0365).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Final model
r  # This will be the final model with the specified dimensions and shape.

wall = 0.008
inner_size = outer_size - 2 * wall

    cq.Workplane("XY")
